_comment: MarginIQ DRAM die / process-node knowledge base (read by rmt_dram.py).
Every value carries a 'basis' and (where public) 'sources'. Allowed basis labels:
Published, Industry consensus, Community-sourced, Engineering Estimate, Not publicly disclosed, JEDEC.
Values decoded from the run's own SPD dump are added at run time with basis 'Log (SPD)'.
Never add an unlabelled guess. Do not cite confidential/NDA vendor datasheets here.
To add a part: (1) add/extend a decoder under vendors.<Vendor>.decoders (regex with named groups;
the group 'die_rev' is used for the node lookup), (2) add a 'dies' entry, (3) point it to a node_families entry.
disclaimer: Vendors do not publish per-part process-node geometry; die-revision letters are not publicly mapped to node names. Only values labelled Log (SPD), JEDEC or Published are facts; Engineering Estimates are roadmap-based and must not be used as specification limits.

basis_legend.Log (SPD): decoded from this run's SPD dump
basis_legend.Published: vendor press release or analyst (TechInsights) public article
basis_legend.Engineering Estimate: not published; derived from DRAM scaling practice

refresh.field: tREFI - elevated temperature (85 C < Tcase <= 95 C)
refresh.value: 1.95 us (8,192 REF commands per 16 ms, 2x refresh rate)

codes.435: DDR5 clocked SO-DIMM (CSODIMM, on-module clock driver) - matches SPD byte 3

codes.4G: 4G x 64b (32 GB) - cross-check with SPD-derived module capacity

node.value: Not publicly disclosed by Samsung for the E-die. Samsung 16Gb DDR5 nodes publicly in mass production: 14nm EUV (D1a, Oct-2021) and 12nm-class (D1b, May-2023)
node.note: Samsung press releases name nodes, not die letters; no public TechInsights/Samsung source maps 'E-die' to D1a or D1b.

rows.value: Samsung value not publicly disclosed. Industry range for D1a/D1b: 12-14 nm feature size
6F2 (1T1C) - kept by all DRAM makers through D1a/D1b/D1c
Cell 1,672 nm2, design rule 14.4 nm, bit density 0.315 Gb/mm2 (8Gb DDR4 die) - shows node name != layout F

Not publicly disclosed (TechInsights paywalled). Engineering Estimate: 6F2 layout gives WL pitch = 2F, BL pitch = 3F; F derived from TechInsights cell sizes is larger than the node name (Micron D1a: 1,672 nm2 / 6 -> F ~ 16.7 nm -> WL ~ 33 nm, BL ~ 50 nm)
Not publicly disclosed. Engineering Estimate: high-aspect-ratio cylinder/pillar capacitor, on the order of 50:1 or higher at 1x-nm DRAM nodes
D1b (12nm-class): Samsung states a 'new high-k material that helps increase cell capacitance' (material not named)
Not publicly disclosed. Engineering Estimate: ZrO2-based laminate (ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 'ZAZ'-type) - the standard DRAM capacitor dielectric family at sub-20 nm nodes
Not publicly disclosed. Engineering Estimate: ~10 fF-class per cell
EUV, 5 EUV layers ('a feat not possible with the conventional ArF process')
EUV layer count not stated in Samsung's 12nm-class release

rows.field: Mask count / complexity vs previous node
rows.value: Mask count not disclosed. Published gains vs previous generation - D1a: ~20% wafer productivity, ~20% lower power; D1b: up to 20% wafer productivity, up to 23% lower power
BCAT (buried-channel array transistor, buried word line), 6F2 1T+1C
Not disclosed for this die. Samsung published HKMG for its 512GB DDR5 TSV module (16Gb dies, 2021) and GDDR6 (2018)
Up to 7,200 MT/s (stated for both 14nm EUV and 12nm-class DDR5)
